title: A problem with the internet
instructions: Bir kadın internet şirketini arıyor. Sorunu ve çözümü takip et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Good morning, FastNet. How can I help?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hello. My internet hasn't worked since yesterday evening.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I'm sorry. Have you tried turning the router off and on again?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, twice. It still doesn't work.

script.speaker: a
script.text: OK. I can see there's a problem in your area. Our engineers are working on it.

script.speaker: a
script.text: By four o'clock this afternoon. We will also take five pounds off your next bill.

questions.prompt: Since when hasn't the internet worked?
questions.evidence: My internet hasn't worked since yesterday evening.

questions.prompt: How many times did she turn the router off and on?
What is the cause of the problem?
options: There is a problem in her area.
questions.evidence: there's a problem in your area.

options: take five pounds off her next bill
send an engineer to her house
